1.1 Math

1.1.1 In-Line Math

You can add inline math by using $<text>$: e.g. E = mc^2

1.1.2 Block Equations

You can add block equations as follows by using

$$
    <text>
$$

e.g.: E = mc^2

1.2 Code Blocks

Example code block

#include <iostream>

int main() {
    cout << "hello world!\n";
    return 0;
}
